reading.ru: В первом месяце народ израильский пришел в пустыню Цин и остановился в Кадеше.
reading.question: What did the Israelites do when they arrived in the wilderness of Zin?
reading.explain: The text states 'остановился в Кадеше' - they camped in Kadesh

reading.ru: Там умерла и была похоронена Мирьям.
reading.question: What happened to Miriam?
options: She was healed of her illness
She died and was buried there
She led the people in song
reading.correct: She died and was buried there
reading.explain: The text says 'умерла и была похоронена Мирьям' - Miriam died and was buried there

reading.ru: Возьми посох и вместе со своим братом Аароном собери народ.
reading.question: What was Moses told to do?
options: Take the rod and gather the people with Aaron
reading.correct: Take the rod and gather the people with Aaron
reading.explain: The Lord said 'Возьми посох и вместе со своим братом Аароном собери народ' - Take the rod and with your brother Aaron gather the people

reading.ru: Моисей поднял руку и дважды ударил по скале своим посохом.
reading.question: What did Moses do with the rock?
options: He struck it twice with his staff
reading.correct: He struck it twice with his staff
reading.explanation: The text says 'дважды ударил по скале своим посохом' - struck the rock twice with his staff

reading.ru: За то, что у вас не хватило веры, чтобы доказать израилетянам Мою святость, вы не приведете этот народ в землю, которую Я им даю.
reading.question: Why were Moses and Aaron punished?
options: Because they lacked faith to sanctify God before the Israelites
Because they refused to leave Egypt
reading.correct: Because they lacked faith to sanctify God before the Israelites
reading.explain: The text states their punishment was because 'у вас не хватило веры, чтобы доказать израилетянам Мою святость' - you lacked faith to sanctify Me before the Israelites

reading.ru: Аарон умер там на вершине горы.
reading.question: Where did Aaron die?
options: On the top of Mount Hor
In the camp below the mountain
reading.correct: On the top of Mount Hor
reading.explain: The text says 'Аарон умер там на вершине горы' - Aaron died there on the top of the mountain
